performance_limits: One matched run per version; timings include profiling overhead and normal measurement variation.
Engine logic, order hooks, DAT and mod timing categories overlap; do not add them.
DAT prepare/restore costs estimated from one in 64 calls.
Render time per simulation frame includes multiple render calls; it is not rendered FPS or GPU utilization.

Dedicated map uses mixed Marines, Zealots and Dragoons and selected talents/curses; not every mission or ability combination.
Pathfinding hook was measured on this map; Protoss 8 southern choke was not revalidated in the native engine.
